environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at the instance with nginx reverse proxy to localhost:8080. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume.

config.reverse_proxy: nginx stream module, TCP passthrough to localhost:8080
config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
